newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Higher SAfrica shortage due to govt flows mismatch.
newsitem.headline: Higher SAfrica shortage due to govt flows mismatch.

text.p: A mismatch in government flows was the main reason for the sharp rise in the money market shortage on Monday, Andre Kock, general manager of the Reserve Bank's money and capital markets division, said on Tuesday.
The Reserve Bank said earlier that the shortage jumped 2.424 billion rand to 10.275 billion rand on Monday from 7.851 billion rand on Saturday.
"There was a mismatch in government spending because some of the spending flowed through last week which normally would have flowed through over the weekend," Kock said.
The shortage fell sharply towards the end of last week, easing from 9.571 billion rand on Thursday to 7.876 billion rand on Friday, before falling further at the weekend.
